    • listMethods

      public static void listMethods(Class<?> clazz, Predicate<Method> exclude, Consumer<Method> handler)

      Convenience method to list Method instances from a Class.

      This handles not including Object methods.

      Parameters:
      clazz - Class to extract Procedure names.
      exclude - Predicate to filter out Method instances. May be null to include all.
      handler - Handler for the candidate Method.
